name: Strigadantak Ark

sections.introduction: Strigadantak Ark is a specialized Ayurvedic liquid formulation traditionally used for disorders affecting the female reproductive system, especially uterine dysfunctions and abnormal vaginal discharge. The name itself suggests a medicine intended to destroy or alleviate stri-gada—diseases of women. This formulation combines classical Ayurvedic preparations with selected therapeutic oils and tinctures to create a potent uterine cleanser, anti-inflammatory support, and urinary tract restorative. Traditionally, it has been prescribed in conditions such as Rakta Pradar (menorrhagia / excessive uterine bleeding), Shweta Pradar (leucorrhoea / white discharge), Neela Pradar (bluish discharge) , uterine irritation, menstrual irregularities, painful menstruation, uterine-origin constipation, burning sensations, headache, restlessness, and associated weakness. It is also considered beneficial in urinary complaints such as dysuria, urinary retention, and yellow discoloration of urine. This formulation was initially designed for women suffering from complications associated with infectious reproductive disorders, and later gained recognition for broader gynecological use.
sections.ingredients:
Ashokarishta (Saraca asoca based classical fermented preparation) – 6 oz (~177 ml) 
 Oil Copaiba (Copaifera officinalis resin oil) – 1½ dram (~5.5 ml) 
 Sandalwood Oil (Santalum album) – 10 drops 
 Tincture Cantharides (prepared from Lytta vesicatoria) – 15 drops 
 Liquor Ferri (Iron preparation) – 4 dram (~14.8 ml) 
 Arabic Gum / Gum Acacia (Acacia senegal) – 15 grains (~1 g) 
 Aqua Camphor Concentrated (Cinnamomum camphora based camphor water) – 1½ dram (~5.5 ml) 
 Distilled Water / Steam Water – 2 oz (~59 ml) 

 Additional Ashokarishta may be added to make the total volume 12 oz (~355 ml). 

 Method of Preparation 
 First, Arabic gum is dissolved thoroughly in distilled or steam water. This mixture is then filtered to obtain a smooth mucilage. The therapeutic oils—Copaiba oil and Sandalwood oil—are blended into this mucilage gradually to ensure proper emulsification. 
 Separately, Ashokarishta is taken as the primary liquid base, and the remaining ingredients such as Tincture Cantharides, Liquor Ferri, and concentrated camphor water are added carefully. Finally, both mixtures are combined and adjusted with additional Ashokarishta until the total volume reaches approximately 12 oz (355 ml). 
 The final preparation is stored in a clean amber bottle and shaken well before use. 

 Therapeutic Properties 
 Strigadantak Ark is considered: 

 Garbhashaya Shodhak (uterine purifier) 
 Pradar Nashak (helps reduce abnormal discharge) 
 Vedana Shamak (pain-relieving) 
 Rakta Stambhak (supports control of excessive bleeding) 
 Mutrala (urinary corrective) 
 Balya (strength promoting) 
 Pitta-Kapha balancing in reproductive channels 

 Its multi-dimensional action makes it useful in chronic inflammatory uterine conditions. 

 Role of Key Ingredients 
 Ashokarishta is one of the most renowned Ayurvedic formulations for female reproductive health. Ashoka (Saraca asoca) is known for strengthening uterine tissues and regulating menstrual flow. 
 Copaiba Oil provides anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial action, especially useful in chronic irritation and infections. 
 Sandalwood Oil soothes burning sensations and supports cooling in inflammatory gynecological conditions. 
 Liquor Ferri supports blood health and addresses weakness associated with chronic discharge or prolonged bleeding. 
 Arabic Gum helps stabilize the mixture while also providing a soothing effect. 
 Camphor Water offers antimicrobial and cooling benefits.
sections.indications:
Strigadantak Ark is traditionally indicated in: 

 Uterine disorders 
 Excessive menstrual bleeding 
 Leucorrhoea 
 Chronic vaginal discharge 
 Burning sensation in uterus 
 Irregular menstruation 
 Dysmenorrhea 
 Constipation due to uterine dysfunction 
 Restlessness and weakness 
 Eye burning and headache 
 Urinary burning 
 Dribbling of urine 
 Yellow urine 
 Urinary obstruction 


 Duration of Use 
 In chronic conditions, it may be administered for 2–3 months with proper dietary discipline (Pathya Palan). 

 Special Clinical Note 
 Historically, this formulation was first prepared for women suffering from complications of infectious reproductive disorders. It was later tested in non-infectious gynecological conditions and reportedly used in over 50,000 female patients, establishing its reputation as a dependable uterine restorative. 

 Additional Advice 
 If the discharge is purulent or foul-smelling, uterine cleansing with antiseptic washes is advised. Thereafter, local applications such as Dhatakyadi Taila or Nataadi Taila may be considered for enhanced healing. 

 Conclusion 
 Strigadantak Ark is a thoughtfully designed Ayurvedic formulation addressing both uterine and urinary disorders in women. Its blend of classical Ayurvedic wisdom and functional medicinal ingredients makes it highly effective in chronic gynecological disturbances. With its cleansing, strengthening, and balancing properties, it remains a valuable preparation in traditional women’s healthcare.
